goals.text: kmaudit's tests pass on a machine with no git config.

outcomes.change: kmaudit's test git helper always commits with its own identity
outcomes.checked_by: packages/kmaudit/tests run with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 and pass

problems.text: kmaudit's tests commit without a git identity, so they fail on any machine with no git user, CI's runner included.
